description: LLM smoke test script and Ollama runtime documentation. Create scripts/llm-smoke.sh that sends a fixed prompt with JSON schema format to Ollama model (default phi3:mini from OLLAMA_MODEL env), validates response against schema, prints tokens/sec and CPU/GPU status. Document Ollama systemd setup in docs/ENVIRONMENT.md.
steps: Create docs/ENVIRONMENT.md with sections: ## System Requirements (WSL2, Ubuntu, kernel >= 5.15, systemd, cgroup v2, 4GB+ RAM, 20GB+ disk), ## Toolchain Versions (Rust 1.87.0 via rust-toolchain.toml, Node 24 via .nvmrc, Python 3.13 via uv), ## Ollama Setup (Install: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh, verify systemd service: systemctl --user status ollama, verify listening on 127.0.0.1:11434: ss -ltnp | grep 11434, pull model: ollama pull phi3:mini, GPU passthrough: verify nvidia-smi shows GPU inside WSL via Windows driver, CPU fallback: document that without GPU inference runs on CPU), ## Bootstrap Process (run scripts/bootstrap.sh, lists all sudo commands: apt-get install, systemctl if touching ollama service, any wsl.conf edits), ## Secret Management (location: ~/.config/intellishell/secret, mode 0600, never tracked by git, generated by bootstrap.sh)

Create scripts/llm-smoke.sh: shebang #!/usr/bin/env bash, set -euo pipefail. Source config/default.env for OLLAMA_MODEL. Check if Ollama is running: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags || exit with error. Define fixed prompt and JSON schema (e.g., {type: object, properties: {safe: {type: boolean}, reason: {type: string}}, required: [safe, reason]}). Send request to Ollama API: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate -d '{model: OLLAMA_MODEL, prompt: <fixed prompt>, format: <schema>, stream: false}' | jq . Parse response JSON: extract .response field and validate it matches schema using jq. Extract .eval_count and .eval_duration, calculate tokens/sec: eval_count / (eval_duration / 1e9). Check if GPU was used: if response contains cuda or gpu in load_duration field, print GPU, else print CPU. Print summary: Model: <model>, Tokens/sec: <tps>, Device: <CPU|GPU>. Exit 0 if validation passes, exit 1 if not.
Run shellcheck on script and fix issues
Test the script (requires Ollama running): bash scripts/llm-smoke.sh (may need manual test or note that CI will skip this)
Commit: git add docs/ENVIRONMENT.md scripts/llm-smoke.sh && git commit -m 'feat(llm): smoke test script and Ollama documentation'
acceptance_criteria: docs/ENVIRONMENT.md exists with all required sections: System Requirements, Toolchain Versions, Ollama Setup, Bootstrap Process, Secret Management
scripts/llm-smoke.sh exists, is executable, is shellcheck-clean
Script validates JSON schema format from Ollama response
Script prints tokens/sec and CPU/GPU device
Script exits 0 on success, 1 on failure
verification: test -f docs/ENVIRONMENT.md && grep -E 'Ollama Setup|System Requirements|Toolchain Versions' docs/ENVIRONMENT.md
